svg.text: JSAUX Pixel Matrix: where to solder
Component side, USB-C on the right. Only the parts you need to find are drawn.
CLOSE-UP: U10, U20 AND TEST PADS
Pins 1–10 are the bottom row, numbered left to right from the dot. Pins 11–20 (top row) get no wires.
Pin 1 = 5.1 V, pin 10 = ground (orange): keep clear.
U10 pins 2, 3 = pad “1” · U10 pin 6 = pad “2” · pins 4–5 (U10), 5–6 and 7–8 (U20) are tied on the board.
Traced from a photo; positions approximate.
